faq_heading: Homes near Clearbrook Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Clearbrook Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Abbotsford School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Clearbrook Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Clearbrook Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Clearbrook Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are W J Mouat Secondary (1.0 km south), Colleen And Gordie Howe Middle School (1.0 km south) and Mennonite Educational Institute (1.2 km north-west).

Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Clearbrook Elementary.
How the Clearbrook Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Clearbrook Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit some distance away. Ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Clearbrook Elementary

18 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Clearbrook Elementary in a straight line (9 elementary, 3 secondary, 3 middle, 3 other; 4 independent). The closest is W J Mouat Secondary, 1.0 km away, and the farthest on this list is Abbotsford Traditional School, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Dr Roberta Bondar Elementary (1.3 km); the nearest independent school is Mennonite Educational Institute (1.2 km). Other elementary schools close by: Dr Roberta Bondar Elementary (1.3 km east), Harry Sayers Elementary (1.5 km west), John Maclure Community School (1.8 km south-east), Ten Broeck Elementary (2.1 km south), Blue Jay Elementary (2.5 km south-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-5) is Dr Roberta Bondar Elementary, 1.3 km east of Clearbrook Elementary.
